---
title: "{{title}}"
params:
  id: "{{id}}"
---

```{r setup}
library(fhperf)
built <- readRDS(file.path(if (file.exists("_data/metrics.rds")) "." else "..", "_data", "metrics.rds"))
id <- params$id
m <- get_metric(built$catalogue, id)
x <- built$metrics[[id]]
s <- built$summaries[built$summaries$id == id, ]
```

`r m$description`

```{r chart}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("SPC chart of", m$title)
plot_metric(x)
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="false" appearance="minimal"}
## Latest period

```{r latest}
latest <- data.frame(
  Period = format(s$period, "%B %Y"),
  Value = format_value(s$value, m),
  Mean = format_value(s$mean, m),
  Variation = gsub("_", " ", s$variation),
  Target = if (is.na(s$target)) "none" else format_value(s$target, m),
  Assurance = if (is.na(s$assurance)) "n/a" else s$assurance,
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(latest)
```
:::

## Definition

```{r definition}
#| results: asis
cat("- **Id:** `", id, "` (domain `", id_domain(id), "`, ", built$catalogue$domains[[id_domain(id)]]$title, ")\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Type:** ", m$type, if (m$type != "count") paste0(" (× ", format(m$multiplier), if (m$divisor != 1) paste0(" ÷ ", format(m$divisor)), ")"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Grain:** ", m$grain, "\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Improvement direction:** ", m$improvement_direction, "\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(m$target)) cat("- **Target:** ", format_value(m$target, m), "\n", sep = "")
comps <- metric_components(m)
for (role in names(comps)) {
  comp <- get_component(built$catalogue, comps[[role]])
  label <- if (comps[[role]] == id) paste0(tools::toTitleCase(role), " (itself)") else tools::toTitleCase(role)
  cat("\n### ", label, ": ", comp$title, " {#", comps[[role]], "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("`", comp$id, "` · ", comp$aggregate, if (!is.null(comp$unit)) paste0(" of ", comp$unit), " · source `", comp$source, "`\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(comp$description, "\n\n")
  cat("```sql\n", component_sql(built$catalogue, comp$id), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Data

```{r data}
tab <- as.data.frame(x)
tab$period <- format(tab$period, "%b %Y")
tab$value <- format_value(tab$value, m)
tab$numerator <- formatC(tab$numerator, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
tab$denominator <- if (m$type == "count") NULL else formatC(tab$denominator, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
names(tab) <- tools::toTitleCase(names(tab))
knitr::kable(tab[nrow(tab):1, ], row.names = FALSE, align = "r")
```
